title: The Little Cloud Who Wanted to Rain
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A timid little cloud learns that letting go can be the bravest thing of all.
long_description: Nimbus is a small cloud who loves floating in the sky, but he's terrified of raining. While all the other clouds joyfully water the world below, Nimbus holds himself together tightly, afraid he'll disappear if he lets go. But when he sees a thirsty garden and a sad little sparrow, he must find the courage to help. Through this gentle adventure, Nimbus discovers that letting go doesn't mean disappearing—it means becoming part of something beautiful. A heartwarming story about courage, self-confidence, and the joy of giving.

main_characters.personality: Timid, thoughtful, caring, brave when needed
